title: Shadow-boxing arms

steps.text: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, one foot a little ahead, and your knees soft.
steps.cue: Feet apart, one a little ahead. Knees soft.

steps.text: Make loose fists and hold them in front of your chin with your elbows down.
steps.cue: Loose fists by your chin, elbows down.

steps.text: Reach one fist forward at shoulder height, then bring it back. Do not snap the elbow straight.
steps.cue: Reach one fist forward. Elbow stays soft.

steps.text: Change arms each time, at a steady pace.
steps.cue: Change arms each time. Steady pace.

mistakes: Lifting the shoulders up toward the ears.
regression: Reach more slowly and not as far, or do it sitting on a sturdy chair.
stopIf: Stop if you feel dizzy, sick, very short of breath, or any pain in your chest.

anatomy.why: Reaching the arms forward in turn keeps the shoulders and arms moving, which raises your breathing.
